items.description: Maliana is a central city located in the Bobonaro municipality. It serves as an important agricultural hub for the surrounding region.
Suai is a coastal town in the Cova Lima municipality. It has recently gained significance due to local petroleum exploration activities.
Lospalos is located in the eastern part of the country. It is known for its distinct Fataluku cultural traditions and architecture.
Viqueque is the capital of the Viqueque municipality on the southern coast. The area features extensive rice fields and tropical forests.
Same is the capital of the Manufahi municipality. It sits in a mountainous area known for coffee cultivation and challenging terrain.
Liquica is a coastal town located west of Dili. It is historically significant and known for its scenic shoreline and colonial-era architecture.
Aileu is located in the mountains south of Dili. It is a peaceful upland town serving as an important market for local mountain farmers.
Ainaro is situated in the high mountains of central Timor-Leste. The climate is notably cooler than the coastal lowlands, ideal for fruit and vegetable growing.
Manatuto is a coastal town located between Dili and Baucau. It lies at the mouth of a river and serves as a local transit point.
Gleno is the capital of the Ermera municipality. It is deeply connected to the local coffee production industry that drives the regional economy.
